acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic test expires the lease between admission and commit of a WORKER add and shows the add refused, with no partial write.
The knowHow fencing behaviour is either kept with a recorded rationale or added to handoffIgnoredKeys, with a test and a spec amendment.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

V1-0987 (docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0987-worker-know-how.md, Limits; GitHub beamfall/corvint#671): there is no concurrency witness for a lease that expires while a WORKER KNOWHOW_ADD is in flight (the check reads the attempt under the same lock as the write), and a change to the policy knowHow key fences every open handoff with STALE_POLICY because it is not in handoffIgnoredKeys. Owner questions retained: whether knowHow should be handoff-ignored, retry behaviour after the key is removed, and that supervised attempts never expire for this check.
title: Tasks know-how WORKER grant: lease-expiry-during-add witness and policy-change fencing decision
